newsitem.title: USA: Interstate General names president, CFO.
newsitem.headline: Interstate General names president, CFO.

text.p: Interstate General Company LP said Edwin L. Kelly was named president and chief operating officer, and J. Michael Wilson was named vice chairman and chief financial officer.
Wilson is replacing John E. Hans, who resigned.
Kelly has been an officer of IGC since 1973, most recently as senior vice president, and served as its treasurer from 1973-1986.
IGC is a diversified real estate organization specializing in community development, homebuilding, investment apartment properties and asset management services.
